formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryPrimePowerTrace.flat_trace_natDegree (f : (ZMod 2)[X]) (hf : f.Monic) (hi : Irreducible f)
    (q e : ℕ) (hq : q.Prime) (hq2 : q ≠ 2)
    (hn : ∀ b : AdjoinRoot f, b ^ q ≠ AdjoinRoot.root f)
    (horder : orderOf (2 : ZMod q) = f.natDegree) (hcop : q.Coprime f.natDegree) :
    (minpoly (ZMod 2) (traceElement (AdjoinRoot.root (f.comp (X ^ (q ^ (e + 1)))))
      f.natDegree (q ^ (e + 1)))).natDegree = q ^ (e + 1) := by sorry
docstring:
The trace in the explicitly specified flat odd-prime-power quotient has exactly
the requested prime-power degree over the binary field.
module_doc: /-! # Exact degree of the odd-prime Shoup trace -/

theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.toBits_ofBits (l : BitStr) (hlen : l.length = f.natDegree) :

/-!
# Coordinates for arbitrary monic binary polynomial quotients

The basis and coefficient representation require only monicity. In particular,
the modulus need not be irreducible or squarefree. The abstract coordinate maps
are used in proofs; the executable addition and multiplication are the existing
uniform coefficient-list programs.
-/

    AdjoinRoot.root f ^ p.length = evalBits (AdjoinRoot.root f) p := by sorry
docstring: The quotient root satisfies the lower-coefficient reduction equation.

formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.splitBits_encoding (p : BitStr) (hp : p.length = f.natDegree)
    (hpoly : f = polyOfBits (p ++ [true])) (e b : AdjoinRoot f) :
    splitBits p (toBits f hf e) (toBits f hf b) =
      (splitComponent e b).map (toBits f hf) := by sorry
docstring: The encoded split is exactly the abstract idempotent split.
module_doc:
/-!
# Bounded component separation in binary polynomial quotients

Refine the unit by a supplied family of Frobenius-fixed vectors. The component
count is clipped to the quotient dimension on every iteration; the algebraic
orthogonality invariant proves that clipping is inert on valid inputs.
-/

formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.quotientComponentsProg_correct (p : BitStr) (hp : p.length = f.natDegree)
    (hpoly : f = polyOfBits (p ++ [true])) (hp0 : p ≠ []) :
    quotientComponentsProg p = (components f hf).map (toBits f hf) := by sorry
docstring: The uniform program computes precisely the abstract primitive components.

formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.componentFactor_dvd_iff (f E H : Polynomial (ZMod 2))
    (he : AdjoinRoot.mk f E * AdjoinRoot.mk f E = AdjoinRoot.mk f E) :
    componentFactor f E ∣ H ↔ AdjoinRoot.mk f E * AdjoinRoot.mk f H = 0 := by sorry
docstring: An idempotent's supported factor describes its polynomial annihilator.
module_doc:
/-!
# Extracting polynomial factors from primitive quotient components

An idempotent represented by `E` corresponds to the factor `gcd(f,E-1)`.
Its multiples are exactly the polynomials annihilated by that component.
Primitive-component inverses therefore prove irreducibility without a Chinese
remainder construction or an enumeration of the quotient ring.
-/

formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.componentFactor_prime (f E : Polynomial (ZMod 2)) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    [Finite (AdjoinRoot f)]
    (hsq : Function.Bijective (fun x : AdjoinRoot f => x * x))
    (he : PrimitiveBinaryComponent (AdjoinRoot.mk f E)) :
    Prime (componentFactor f E) := by sorry
docstring: A primitive component of a quotient with bijective squaring yields a prime factor.

theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.componentFactor_isCoprime (f E H : Polynomial (ZMod 2))

    (heh : AdjoinRoot.mk f E * AdjoinRoot.mk f H = 0) :
    IsCoprime (componentFactor f E) (componentFactor f H) := by sorry
docstring: Orthogonal components cannot share a nonunit supported factor.

theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.componentFactors_prod (f : Polynomial (ZMod 2)) (hf : f.Monic)
    [Finite (AdjoinRoot f)]
    (hsq : Function.Bijective (fun x : AdjoinRoot f => x * x))
    {n : ℕ} (E : Fin n → Polynomial (ZMod 2))
    (he : ∀ i, PrimitiveBinaryComponent (AdjoinRoot.mk f (E i)))
    (horth : Pairwise (fun i j => AdjoinRoot.mk f (E i) * AdjoinRoot.mk f (E j) = 0))
    (hsum : ∑ i, AdjoinRoot.mk f (E i) = 1) :
    ∏ i, componentFactor f (E i) = f := by sorry
docstring: A complete orthogonal primitive family reconstructs its monic quotient modulus.

theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.componentFactors_list_prod (f : Polynomial (ZMod 2)) (hf : f.Monic)
    [Finite (AdjoinRoot f)]
    (hsq : Function.Bijective (fun x : AdjoinRoot f => x * x))
    (l : List (Polynomial (ZMod 2)))
    (hl : ComponentFamily (l.map (AdjoinRoot.mk f)))
    (he : ∀ E ∈ l, PrimitiveBinaryComponent (AdjoinRoot.mk f E)) :
    (l.map (componentFactor f)).prod = f := by sorry
docstring: The reconstruction theorem in the list representation used by the programs.

theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.componentFactors_toBits_prod (f : Polynomial (ZMod 2)) (hf : f.Monic)
    [Finite (AdjoinRoot f)]
    (hsq : Function.Bijective (fun x : AdjoinRoot f => x * x))
    (l : List (AdjoinRoot f)) (hl : ComponentFamily l)
    (he : ∀ e ∈ l, PrimitiveBinaryComponent e) :
    (l.map (fun e => componentFactor f (polyOfBits (toBits f hf e)))).prod = f := by sorry
docstring: Canonical representatives of a primitive component family yield the complete factorization.

theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.frobeniusMatrixProg_correct (p : BitStr)
    (hp : p.length = f.natDegree) (hpoly : f = polyOfBits (p ++ [true])) :
    frobeniusMatrixProg p = matrixBits (frobeniusMatrix f hf) := by sorry

theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.fixedMatrix_ker (x : AdjoinRoot f) :

theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.linearMulCarry_width (p a carry : BitStr) (cs : List BitStr)
    (ha : a.length = p.length) (hc : carry.length = p.length)
    (hs : ∀ c ∈ cs, c.length = p.length) :
    ∀ c ∈ linearMulCarry p a carry cs, c.length = p.length := by sorry
docstring: The carried linear multiplication preserves correct coefficient widths.

formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.coeffPolynomial_linearMulCarry [CharP R 2] (z : R)
    (p a carry : BitStr) (cs : List BitStr)
    (hz : z ^ p.length = evalBits z p)
    (ha : a.length = p.length) (hc : carry.length = p.length)
    (hs : ∀ c ∈ cs, c.length = p.length) :
    coeffPolynomial z (linearMulCarry p a carry cs) =
      C (evalBits z carry) + (X + C (evalBits z a)) * coeffPolynomial z cs := by sorry
docstring: Linear multiplication has exactly the expected polynomial semantics.
module_doc: /-! # Polynomial products with coefficients in an explicit binary quotient -/

formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.coeffPolynomial_addCoeffLists [CharP R 2] (z : R) (as bs : List BitStr) (n : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ a ∈ as, a.length = n) (hb : ∀ b ∈ bs, b.length = n) :
    coeffPolynomial z (addCoeffLists as bs) = coeffPolynomial z as + coeffPolynomial z bs := by sorry
docstring: Coefficient-list addition implements addition of the interpreted polynomials.
module_doc: /-! # Polynomial arithmetic with supplied binary-quotient coefficient vectors -/

formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.length_mulCoeffLists_le (p : BitStr) (as bs : List BitStr) :
    (mulCoeffLists p as bs).length ≤ as.length + bs.length := by sorry
docstring: Each multiplication output has at most the sum of the input coefficient counts.
module_doc: /-! # Polynomial arithmetic with supplied binary-quotient coefficient vectors -/

formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.mulCoeffLists_width (p : BitStr) (as bs : List BitStr)
    (ha : ∀ a ∈ as, a.length = p.length) :
    ∀ c ∈ mulCoeffLists p as bs, c.length = p.length := by sorry
docstring: Multiplication preserves valid quotient coefficient widths.
module_doc: /-! # Polynomial arithmetic with supplied binary-quotient coefficient vectors -/

formal_statement:
theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.coeffPolynomial_mulCoeffLists [CharP R 2] (z : R) (p : BitStr) (as bs : List BitStr)
    (hz : z ^ p.length = evalBits z p) (ha : ∀ a ∈ as, a.length = p.length) :
    coeffPolynomial z (mulCoeffLists p as bs) = coeffPolynomial z as * coeffPolynomial z bs := by sorry
docstring: Horner multiplication agrees with multiplication of the interpreted polynomials.
module_doc: /-! # Polynomial arithmetic with supplied binary-quotient coefficient vectors -/

theorem MIPRE.LowDegree.BinaryQuotient.mulCoeffLists_width_le (p : BitStr) (as bs : List BitStr) (N : ℕ)
    (hp : p.length ≤ N) (ha : ∀ a ∈ as, a.length ≤ N) :
    ∀ c ∈ mulCoeffLists p as bs, c.length ≤ N := by sorry
